title: The Indoor Park
can_do: 计划被打乱时（下雨），提出“那我们改做……”的替代方案。

conversation_move.label: adapt a plan when it is disrupted

trigger: Rain cancels the park plan, and Child proposes an indoor version instead.
setting: A rainy morning at the entryway.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Bad news, buddy. It's raining outside.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: So we can't go to the park today?

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Not today. The slides would be all wet.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: What if we build an indoor park instead?

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: An indoor park? How would that work?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Cushions for hills, and the mat for sliding!

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: That sounds fun. Let's do it after lunch.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Rainy days can't stop us now!

replay_cards.title: The closed pool
replay_cards.change: The pool is closed for cleaning.
replay_cards.challenge: Child proposes the sprinkler park instead and helps pack the dry clothes and towels.

replay_cards.title: The missing flour
replay_cards.challenge: Child suggests oat cookies instead and helps mash the bananas for the new plan.

parent_support: 计划被打断时别急着替孩子想替代方案，先问“那我们可以在家玩什么”。
孩子的替代方案哪怕奇怪也先试一轮，再一起修正。
把“下雨天也挺好”的态度传给孩子，比方案本身重要。
